Chapter 735: Chapter 26: The Resolute Supreme Being (Please Subscribe)

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan, his mind racing with thoughts.

As a Twelfth-Rank Life, how fast could Xia Qin Supreme Being’s cognitive speed possibly be?

In just an instant, he deduced the many possible reasons why Lin Yuan would inquire about the Witch Ancestor’s Twentieth Realm.

The most likely reason he came up with was that Lin Yuan had already reached the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm.

It would be normal for someone at the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm to want to learn about the mysteries of the Witch Ancestor’s Twentieth Realm.

But that reason seemed too incredible to believe.

...

Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm? In the Two-dimensional World, it was debatable whether any of those mythic perfect-Level Eleven beings had reached that level.

Lin Yuan was merely a Tenth Rank Life, no matter how heaven-defying he was, surely there had to be some limits?

Beyond that possibility, Xia Qin Supreme Being also deduced many other potential reasons.

For example, Lin Yuan might want to see further ahead, know the general idea of the Witch Ancestor’s Twentieth Realm, or he could just be asking out of pure curiosity, among others.

“What level of Witch Ancestor are you now?” Xia Qin Supreme Being, after a moment of silence, couldn’t help but ask.

The Two-dimensional World within White Paper could block a Supreme Being’s probing.

So even Xia Qin Supreme Being couldn’t determine Lin Yuan’s specific Realm level.

“I am now…” Lin Yuan pondered for a moment and didn’t hide the truth, “Nineteenth Realm.”

When facing a Supreme Being from his clan, instances like the Door to the Myriad Realms and the Mysterious Gourd, which were opportunities far surpassing Twelfth Rank, Lin Yuan would choose to conceal them. As for everything else, there was no need for concealment.

In the World of the Two-dimensional, one must accurately reveal their strength to receive guidance from Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Lin Yuan held great admiration for Supreme Beings; every life-form that had become a Supreme Being was extremely resolute. Merely relying on innate talent was not enough to reach the Ultimate level.

“Really at the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm?” Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan, although he had already anticipated it in his mind.

But, when Lin Yuan personally confirmed it, Xia Qin Supreme Being was still somewhat shocked.

The nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization had joined hands to replicate a Two-dimensional World within ‘Void Realm World,’ descending within it to carry out deductions for nearly a hundred years, before they finally arrived at the cultivation methods spanning from the first to the Sixteenth Realm of Witch Ancestor.

And here was Lin Yuan who had, on his own, stepped into the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm?

Admittedly, the ‘Two-dimensional World’ that the nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization descended into, created forcibly by Void Realm World, was only somewhat similar to the actual one.

And the cultivation methods they deduced were not limited to any single being but could be popularized to some extent.

In terms of difficulty, it was definitely higher than the cultivation methods figured out by the powerhouses within the actual Two-dimensional World.

But they were Supreme Beings! They were Ultimate beings! They were Twelfth-Rank Lifes!

The insight and eyesight of a Supreme Being were far superior to those of a Tier 11 being, let alone Lin Yuan who was merely Tenth Rank.

Under these circumstances, it was understandable that those perfect-Level Eleven legendary beings would explore up to the Witch Ancestor Eighteenth Realm and Nineteenth Realm, but Lin Yuan?

“You?” Xia Qin Supreme Being sighed, “You really surprised me.”

Initially, when one of Lin Yuan’s Avatars fell into the Two-dimensional World, Xia Qin Supreme Being was extremely worried that it might affect Lin Yuan’s prospects of reaching the Ultimate level.

The collaboration of Human Civilization’s nine Supreme Beings to stimulate Void Realm World and replicate the Two-dimensional World was not without great cost.

Nevertheless, Xia Qin Supreme Being insisted on acting out of concern that Lin Yuan’s Avatar might actually be lost in the Two-dimensional World.

But now it seemed that Xia Qin Supreme Being’s concerns were completely unnecessary.

If Lin Yuan truly possessed the strength of Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm, his life in that Two-dimensional World must be quite comfortable.

“Indeed, it was not long ago that I barely stepped into the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm,” Lin Yuan said immediately.

“Not long ago?”

“Barely?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being glanced at Lin Yuan.

“If you could cultivate to the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm in such a short period of time, there was no need for our Human Civilization to actively seek the Star Alliance,” Xia Qin Supreme Being stated with a smile on his face.

“Seek the Star Alliance?”

Lin Yuan was slightly startled.

The Star Alliance was a coalition of many unique life-forms within the Cosmic Starry Skies, counted among the same level of power as the grand alliances of Peak Clans like Human Civilization.

“Without seeking the Star Alliance, it will be quite difficult to take out the treasures from the Two-dimensional World,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said, “So far, the Four Divine Kings of the Star Alliance are the ones most likely to go through the heavenly gate and return to the Cosmic Starry Sky.”

“The treasures attained by the Evolvers of our Human Civilization in the Two-dimensional World can be brought out only with the help of the Four Divine Kings,” explained Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Those treasures would only show their greatest value once out of the Two-dimensional World.

However, Human Civilization’s Evolvers were not dominant in the Two-dimensional World; at least based on the current situation, they were unable to compete with formidable beings like the Four Divine Kings for a chance to enter the heavenly gate.

But now, upon learning of Lin Yuan’s strength, hope suddenly rose in Xia Qin Supreme Being’s heart.

Given Lin Yuan’s current Realm, even if he still wasn’t a match for the Four Divine Kings, he could completely set his sights on the opening of the heavenly gate after the next one.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

To beg the Star Alliance, to ask the Four Divine Kings, would surely come with a greater price, as it was a plea after all.

But Human Civilization had no other choice, given that in the Two-dimensional World, the advantages of special life-forms were infinitely amplified.

Not just Human Civilization, but the Insect Race, the Tianyu Clan, and other Peak Clans, were similarly unable to compete with the special life-forms of the Star Alliance in the Two-dimensional World.

“Of course, if you can leave the Two-dimensional World through the heavenly gate later on and take out those treasures from our Human Civilization, you certainly won’t be doing it for nothing. For each treasure, based on its value, you will get a fifty percent share.”
